CustomField.description: Used to display colored icons for engagement status using Static Resources.
CustomField.formula: IF( Blacklisted__c, IMAGE("/resource/Blacklisted", "Blacklisted", 20, 89), IF( AND( DoNotCall, HasOptedOutOfEmail ), IMAGE("/resource/Do_Not_Contact", "Do Not Contact", 20, 115), IF( DoNotCall, IMAGE("/resource/Do_Not_Call", "Do Not Call", 20, 90), IF( HasOptedOutOfEmail, IMAGE("/resource/Do_Not_Email", "Do Not Email", 20, 101), IF( ISPICKVAL( Account.Type, "Customer" ), IMAGE("/resource/Customer", "Customer", 20, 81), IF( ISPICKVAL( Account.Type, "Prospect" ), IMAGE("/resource/Prospect", "Prospect", 20, 76), "" ))))))
CustomField.label: Engagement Status
